name: Skinory
description: Independent Counter-Strike 2 and CS:GO skins reference: live best-offer prices, collections and cases, the weekly drop pool, Steam inventory valuation, professional teams and players.

apis.name: Skinory Public API v1
apis.description: Read-only JSON API: item prices and price history, public Steam inventory valuation, professional teams and players. Prices in USD from public market feeds and the Steam Community Market. An optional API key raises the limits.
